source: Marvel Studios (Russos at SDCC 2024); official cast list, March 26, 2025
whereTheyAre: Doom rules Latveria and is the film's main antagonist. An August special look shows him fighting Thor and raising Sentinels. In the final trailer he stands among Latverian followers and tells the heroes they have lived 'stolen lives' they must give back. The Endgame Encore shows him forging his mask, and in another scene an unseen voice, widely read as Doom, comes to collect Bruce Banner. A hooded figure who wakes Wanda in the VisionQuest finale is also read as Doom.
whyItMatters: He is the reason heroes from several universes end up in one fight. Whether he is somehow a Tony Stark echo is the biggest open question, although Kevin Feige has said on record that he is simply Victor von Doom.

source: Marvel teaser, Dec 24, 2025 (first Doomsday teaser ends on a Steve Rogers return card); appears in the Nov 23, 2026 final trailer
whereTheyAre: Steve stayed in the past with Peggy at the end of Endgame. The first teaser showed him holding a baby, and the final trailer shows him at home with Peggy and a teenage son until the Fantastic Four arrive and ask if he is Steve Rogers. He later summons Mjolnir and reunites with Thor and Bucky.
whyItMatters: He is the emotional centre of the marketing, and the Fantastic Four seem to need him. Marvel has not explained why, and has not said what role he plays.

source: Marvel Studios panel, San Diego Comic-Con, July 2026 (Hayley Atwell); also in the Nov 23, 2026 final trailer
whereTheyAre: Peggy is shown with Steve in the final trailer, asking him whether their son does not already know who he is. She also appears in the Endgame Encore extended ending, where Loki knocks on their door offering help. Outlets note it is unclear which version of Peggy this is.
whyItMatters: Her family is the stakes on Earth: the trailer sets up Steve having to leave them. Whether the choice to live in the past matters to Doom is speculation.

whyItMatters: Likely the link between Steve's choice, Doom, and the collapsing universes. Whether he is ally, guide or something darker is open.
